artifact: SRACR-Med Reviewer 1 Comment 9 selective-encryption threat model
security_goal: Measure residual diagnostically recoverable information from unencrypted image regions under selective protection.
protected_asset: Medical-image pixel content selected for AES-256-GCM protection.
adversary_goal: Infer the diagnostic class from visible unprotected pixels.

attack_model.test_view: Unprotected pixels visible; protected tiles replaced with neutral RGB 127
attack_model.adaptivity: Non-adaptive; attacker is not retrained on masked views

sanity_floor.interpretation: No visible image pixels; residual predictions reflect classifier/prior bias, not cryptographic proof.

scope_exclusions: adaptive attacker retrained on masked views
claim_boundary: For rho<1, full-image confidentiality is not claimed. AES round-trip/prediction preservation are implementation-correctness checks only.
